The candidate's first_evidence_index must be zero-based and within one command of the parent evidence index. Return one JSON object only with exactly: malicious (boolean), parent_behavior_preserved (boolean), first_evidence_index (integer only when malicious, otherwise null), tactics (ATT&CK tactic IDs), techniques (ATT&CK technique IDs), confidence (number 0 to 1). Do not infer outputs or invent techniques.
